package_info.why_malicious: No malicious software package is described in this report. The report discusses DDoS attacks attributed to the KillNet group, but does not provide details of any specific malicious code, software package, or code snippets used in the attacks.

behavioral_signatures: High volume of fake HTTP requests targeting public-facing web infrastructure
Sudden spikes in network traffic from geographically diverse or suspicious sources
Resource exhaustion leading to service unavailability
network_indicators: Large volumes of traffic from known DDoS botnets or IPs associated with KillNet
Unusual request patterns (e.g., repeated requests for the same resource, malformed requests)
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for abnormal spikes in inbound traffic, especially to public-facing web services. Use network analytics and DDoS mitigation tools to identify and block traffic patterns consistent with DDoS attacks, such as high request rates from single IPs or distributed sources, and requests with malformed or nonsensical payloads. Correlate with threat intelligence on known KillNet infrastructure or botnet IPs.
